### iRhythm Holdings to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


11/06/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/296879096/files/doc_news/iRhythm-Holdings-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conferences-130b2dbda-2026.pdf)


SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[iRhythm Holdings, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=XnUuQ5Ny3JLZzTT1RVdhYKph9MZ2NHXBmxY3Cc5hR-EdCWDa_zKrTkfS6donGkmhHTrKfKUXJZsC7dr61WXdoVorvW6lod1veG7VU3RqDxc=) (NASDAQ: IRTC), a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease, today announced that it will participate in the following investor conferences.


- **Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London** on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. GMT (3:00 a.m. PT)
- **9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference** on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 2:10 p.m. ET (11:10 a.m. PT)
- **Citi’s 2026 Global Healthcare Conference** on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 1:40 p.m. ET (10:40 a.m. PT)


Interested parties may access live and archived webcasts of the presentations on the “Events & Presentations” section of the company’s investor website at[investors.irhythmtech.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Mo2ooPZJaXD-ZNWlU2p4E9UFCk62YBHtwTj5VOZgcUNCTbcotlbw6V7PJBBhgAqVbIaiAOOA4rQSD69iy-LTgZ_UdX_WP1zccZADNVYiTl4B1yvB8Oc9IUr0IlWgwkJNziO4UnHx2Avchj6pQmEtcDhfr4n_bXbnk9Fjai5Ir-YYBj2fFxDl8mDlGAVNVZB7) .


**About iRhythm Holdings, Inc.**
iRhythm is a leading digital health care company with a mission to create trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease. Combining wearable biosensors and cloud-based data analytics with powerful proprietary algorithms, iRhythm distills data from millions of heartbeats into clinically actionable information. Through a relentless focus on patient care, iRhythm’s vision is to deliver better data, better insights, and better health for all.
